appliedEdits.title: prime-agent CLI: /effort levels come from model thinkingLevelMap; Kimi K3 is max-only; models.json override workaround
appliedEdits.content:
Facts discovered by inspecting the installed prime-agent CLI (/home/ubuntu/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/prime-agent):

1. /effort selector options come from getSupportedThinkingLevels(model) in @earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/models.js, which filters EXTENDED_THINKING_LEVELS (off, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max) by the model's thinkingLevelMap in models.generated.js: a null mapped value = level unavailable; xhigh and max additionally require an explicitly defined (non-undefined) mapping. clampThinkingLevel silently clamps unsupported levels before requests are sent.

2. kimi-coding/k3 and kimi-coding/k3-256k ship with a max-only thinkingLevelMap (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh all null, only max:"max"). 13 Kimi K3 variants across providers (moonshotai, fireworks, openrouter, opencode, prime-inference, vercel-ai-gateway, huggingface, kimi-coding, etc.) share this max-only map. This is a registry metadata limitation, not a subscription/API limitation.

Facts discovered by inspecting the installed prime-agent CLI (/home/ubuntu/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/prime-agent):
